definitions.explanation: A soft bun with a sweet filling or topping, such as あんパン, メロンパン or クリームパン, sold at bakeries and convenience stores and often eaten as a snack or quick lunch.

examples.japanese: {菓子|かし}パン⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}う→買う：00489_kau⟧。

examples.english: I just had a sweet bun for breakfast.

examples.japanese: ⟦コンビニ→コンビニ：01081_konbini⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{菓子|かし}パン⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{種類|しゅるい}→種類：01560_shurui⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}くて→多い：01127_ooi⟧、⟦{毎回|まいかい}→毎回：13202_maikai⟧⟦どれ→どれ：00547_dore⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧⟦{迷|まよ}って→迷う：02426_mayou⟧しまう。
examples.english: Convenience stores have so many kinds of sweet buns that I can never decide which one to get.

notes:
⟦{菓子|かし}→菓子：00191_kashi⟧ (sweets) + ⟦パン→パン：00553_pan⟧ (bread). A category of Japanese bakery goods; savory filled buns such as ⟦カレーパン→カレーパン：31844_kareepan⟧ are ⟦{惣菜|そうざい}→惣菜：05827_souzai⟧⟦パン→パン：00553_pan⟧ instead.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {菓子|かし}パン⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧かじる: to munch on a sweet bun
- {菓子|かし}パン⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{済|す}ませる→済ませる：02121_sumaseru⟧: to make do with a sweet bun (for a meal)

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{菓子|かし}→菓子：00191_kashi⟧: confectionery, sweets
- ⟦{食|しょく}パン→食パン：14636_shokupan⟧: plain sandwich bread
- ⟦{惣菜|そうざい}→惣菜：05827_souzai⟧⟦パン→パン：00553_pan⟧: savory bun, filled with curry, croquettes, etc.
